content: My name is Alex Rivera.

My timezone is Europe/Lisbon.

My sister Maya Rivera was born on March 14.

My dog is called Biscuit; he is a golden retriever.

My birthday is July 2.
Reminder: I am allergic to shellfish.

My emergency contact is my sister Maya Rivera, number starts with +49.
I am vegetarian; cook without meat or fish stock.

During today's session we debugged ingest lag on atlas; Alex mentioned the RTX 4080 was running hot while llama.cpp churned embeddings, and wondered whether the Fritz!Box 7590 was throttling uploads; agreed to check the dashboard tomorrow.
Conversation digest: talked about the Porto trip packing list, Biscuit's vet reminder, and whether Casa do Fado allows early check-in; decided to email reservas and ask politely.
Session recap: migrated two repos from GitHub mirrors to GitLab, hit an LFS quota warning, and Alex joked the YubiKey Nano is too easy to lose; action item was ordering a spare key.
Chat log fragment: discussed upgrading Postgres from 15 to 16, port conflicts on 5432, and settled on moving the cluster to 5433; also complained Redis license news pushed us toward alternatives.
Episodic note: while cooking dinner we planned the vegetarian meal-prep grid for the week; oat milk flat white count was three; Biscuit got a bath.
Meeting digest: Thursday Northwind sync covered invoice NW-88231 status, the EKS node upgrade window, and Alex asked to move the recurring slot later in autumn.
Random thought captured mid-afternoon: maybe swap Ghostty font size to 12pt; also the WH-1000XM5 cushions are wearing out; bookmarked a replacement listing.
Debug session summary: Valkey migration rehearsal on the Minisforum box went fine, AOF rewrite took nine minutes, and we noted the old Redis dump remains in /srv/backup as a fallback.
Weekend recap: cycled the Kona Dew along the Tejo, tried a new bakery near Alvalade, watched a documentary about coral reefs; no work done, intentionally.
Late-night idea log: a CLI that greps browser history into mnemosyne; parked until atlas milestone 2 lands; might use the Python rename script as scaffolding.
Support call notes: NOS support escalated the mobile plan question, ticket NOS-77219, promised callback within 48h; Alex reiterated preference for async updates.
Pairing session digest: walked Ines through the atlas repo layout, explained why libsql beat SQLite for vector columns, and sketched the graph expansion module on the whiteboard.
Errand list spoken aloud: pick up piano books at the music shop, renew the gym locker padlock, buy oat milk, and post the passport photocopy to the insurance office.
Podcast note: episode on SQLite internals suggested page_size tuning; considered trying it on the mnemosyne test DB but flagged as low priority.
Weather gripe logged: heat wave week, solar output peaked at 29 kWh/day, Growatt app charts looked great; AC made the office bearable.
Family call recap: Maya confirmed Berlin flat move in spring; parents asked about Thanksgiving flights from Tucson; nothing booked yet.
Shopping research: compared Pixel 9 Pro cases, liked the thin TPU ones; also eyed a Framework laptop for tinkering but the X1 Carbon is still fine.
Cooking experiment recorded: vegetarian pastel de nata attempt failed on custard set; second try with cornstarch worked; Biscuit supervised.
Work rant captured: code review SLA breached twice this sprint; proposed a bot nudge in Zulip; team lead agreed to trial it next sprint.
Conference planning chatter: checked direct flights Lisbon-Amsterdam for RustConf, KLM vs Transavia; leaning KLM for the Tuesday departure.

Reading queue snapshot: Piranesi for book club, Designing Data-Intensive Applications reread, and three Rust RFCs bookmarked from the weekly thread.

Idea sketch: mnemosyne recall latency overlay in the atlas dashboard using the event stream; parked pending milestone 2; would show p95 per query type.
Travel daydream noted: extending Porto trip to the Douro valley weekend; need to check Casa do Fado cancellation terms first.

Music discovery: Navidrome playlist sync finally worked after the compose network fix; added three Fado albums for the Porto train ride.
